rationale: Tests understanding of the primary route of CNS invasion in bacterial meningitis, anchored after the block that establishes the three pathogenetic routes and the cytokine-mediated damage mechanism.
Tests application of the age-based organism correlation to a neonatal clinical scenario, anchored after the block establishing meningitis aetiology by age group.
Addresses the common misconception that TBM has normal CSF glucose like viral meningitis, anchored after the block establishing CSF analysis patterns for all aetiologies.

Tests visual recognition of CSF Gram stain morphology matched to confirmatory culture or identification features, directly addressing the MI6.3 competency of identifying microbial agents from a Gram stain, anchored after the Gram stain interpretation block.
Tests application of epidemiological and CSF clues to diagnose Japanese encephalitis in the Indian context, anchored after the block establishing encephalitis causes and diagnosis.
